subject: Day 20: end of week 3; 1-month visit one week out
bodyText:
Today's focus
Day 20. End of week 3. Avi has been alive for nearly three weeks, gained weight back, navigated his first growth spurt. The 1-month well visit is approximately one week out. Begin compiling the feeding/output log into a summary the pediatrician can scan in 30 seconds.

Action items
- Summarize the feeding log: average feeds per day, average wet/dirty diaper count, longest sleep stretch, any pattern shifts. The pediatrician wants signal, not raw data. AAP Bright Futures parent handouts: https://www.aap.org/en/practice-management/bright-futures/bright-futures-tools-and-resources/
- Schedule the 2-month visit if possible; vaccines are due then (HepB #2, RV #1, DTaP #1, Hib #1, PCV #1, IPV #1). CDC immunization schedule: https://www.cdc.gov/vaccines/hcp/imz-schedules/index.html
- If returning to work at 12 weeks, your last week before return is ~day 80; daycare or nanny commitment should be locked by then.
- Maternal 6-week visit pre-write: pelvic floor symptoms, mood, contraception, sex, exercise return. ACOG on the postpartum period: https://www.acog.org/womens-health/faqs/postpartum-pain-management
- Continue feeding log; it ends at the 1-month visit unless the pediatrician asks otherwise.

Watch-fors
- [low concern] Brief head lifts in tummy time. Some early cooing. Cradle cap on scalp. Increased fussiness during the evening witching hour (5-8pm).
- [low concern] Lochia stopped or barely present.
- [monitor] Persistent crying >3 hours/day fitting colic-curve criteria.
- [call within 24h] Forceful projectile vomiting + weight loss (pyloric stenosis). Fewer than six wet diapers per day. Persistent inability to console + arching back during feeds (possible severe reflux or cow's-milk-protein intolerance).
- [call now] Rectal temperature at or above 100.4F (38.0C). Lethargy, refusal of all feeds, blue or grey color, breathing faster than 60 per minute at rest, persistent grunting, projectile or bilious-green vomiting. Seizure-like activity. Call 911 for blue lips or unresponsiveness!

Enrichment opportunity
Daily read-aloud 10-15 minutes. At this age, board books with high-contrast images and rhythmic text are ideal: Black on White by Tana Hoban, Brown Bear Brown Bear, Goodnight Moon. 1000 Books Before Kindergarten: https://1000booksbeforekindergarten.org/

Upcoming
- Day 28-35: 1-month well visit; first social smiles begin.
- Day 35-42: peak PURPLE crying curve at about 6 weeks.
- Day 42: maternal 6-week postpartum visit.
- Day 56-70: 2-month well visit; first round of vaccines.

Further reading
- CDC immunization schedule: https://www.cdc.gov/vaccines/hcp/imz-schedules/index.html
- 1000 Books Before Kindergarten: https://1000booksbeforekindergarten.org/
- AAP Bright Futures periodicity and parent handouts: https://www.aap.org/en/practice-management/bright-futures/bright-futures-tools-and-resources/
- ACOG on the postpartum period: https://www.acog.org/womens-health/faqs/postpartum-pain-management
